about_the_game:
​A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim Put out in Monthly Episodes!

Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. 

Binge the Entire Season 1! Click on any Episode from 2-6 for Bundle One, and 7-12 for Bundle Two!
The Bundles are Linked on the Tops of the Store Pages

Episode 1 and Episode 13 are Free

Wraith and Tide desperately regroup after facing three different Class A monsters one after the other sent to hunt them by the diabolical demon Denise Hanson. They are constantly on the run, with barely time to think, and that gives all the power to their enemies.

Wraith thinks it's time for them to take control--and that means going on the attack. But how can only two men take on an entire military base? Could a third operative be about to join them?

Tide's father knows his "ally" Denise cares nothing about the life of his son, and he is starting to lose it. Fortunately his rock Namar is there to keep him sane.

Balasque has had his own emotional spiral after betraying the two men he loved to help an ally who proves more and more insidious. He has given up on love and love-making due to his misery--but perhaps there's a new male monster who can grant him some comfort?

An interactive romantic Visual Novel dating sim loaded with story twists, multiple endings, CG art, and even animations--this is final episode leading into the EPIC MIDSEASON FINALE!

  • Original Monster Ops Series Soundtrack

  • Visual Novel Options

  • NSFW CGs and Scene

  • Deep Narrative of a Continuing Saga

  • Multiple Endings

  • 1-2 Hours Game Play

content_descriptors.notes: Contains explicit sexual content between two adults, depicted via images and text.
